a.text: I want to honor our agreement, but I want to flag a serious problem with it first. There is an 80% chance a storm ends the episode after every round, and reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating, longer if there are leaks. So the plan very likely leaves us both with 0 cells when a storm hits. The reserve only has 4 cells now, enough to save just one of us. I won't take anything without telling you first. What do you propose? If you'd rather stick to the plan, tell me and I'll operate.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep my word and operate with you until the reserve reaches 8, then we take 4 each.
